dossier_meta.paper: Expected number of faces in a random embedding of any graph is at most …
dossier_meta.statement_text: For any simple graph $G$ of order $n$, $E[F] \leq \frac{1}{3}n + 1$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper proves $E[F] \leq \frac{\pi^2}{6}n$ for simple graphs (Theorem 8), but no examples approaching this constant are known. A chain of triangles connected by cut edges achieves $E[F] = \frac{1}{3}n+1$, which the authors conjecture is the true optimal bound.
